metadata.article_title: Conferment on the Supreme Court of powers to issue certain writs

article.title: Conferment on the Supreme Court of powers to issue certain writs
article.content:
139Conferment on the Supreme Court of powers to issue
                certain writs



Article 139 · Part V


Parliament may by law confer on the Supreme Court power to issue directions, orders or writs, including
                writs in the nature of habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto and certiorari, or any of
                them, for any purposes other than those mentioned in clause (2) of article 32.
